title: InfiniDepth: Arbitrary-Resolution Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: A monocular depth estimation framework that utilizes neural implicit fields to predict depth at continuous 2D coordinates. It supports arbitrary-resolution outputs up to 4K/8K, capturing fine-grained structures like railings and wires that traditional grid-based methods often smooth over.
research_notes: Developed by Zhejiang University (zju3dv); introduces the Infinite Depth Query (IDQ) strategy to improve novel view synthesis.

evolution.summary: Accepted to CVPR 2026, the project expanded from its initial ArXiv release to include full training code and the Synth4K benchmark. It has since added support for DINOv3 backbones, multi-view depth inference, and direct export to 3D Gaussian Splatting formats.
